answer: Stake-deposit trellis gates each agent vote: fresh identity must burn real tokens before its plume of influence can spread through the network's ranking layer. Influence then grows only when peers verify genuine work output, so each pearl of earned trust maps back to labor actually performed. Sybil attacker's bottleneck: spawning N fake agents means paying full stake-plus-work cost N separate times, turning mass-identity flooding into pure token incineration with zero net gain.
